changes.comment: Fetch finalized blocks from an SQD Portal dataset with `.setPortal()`. The SQD Network v2 archive (gateway) is no longer supported: `.setGateway()`, `.setArchive()`, `.setDataSource()` and the `GatewaySettings`, `ArchiveSettings` and `DataSource` types are removed. RPC data source: `addEvmLog()`, `addEthereumTransaction()` and `addContractsContractEmitted()` without filters no longer select every event or call
